for_ren: One Chinese wording for the meta-attractor on every front, as D1: 胜出又怎样换来左右选择规则的力量：本论把这一回路称为元吸引子 (screen, uses, cover) or 胜出若换来左右选择规则的力量，这样形成的回路便是元吸引子 (one page, overview), its closed form 规则和对规则的解读都由它所选出者所占的份额形成, proved to lock on stated models; the lock alone is not called it.
08 §8's two phrases, now said one way on the screen, the one page, the uses page and the overview: “一套新的形式化成果”（a new artefact）and “一种澄清了、却未奠定根据的伦理”（a clarified ethics, not a grounded one）.
